name: ModelVariant168_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant168_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the French header-178 particles with a cone added: particles rise from a part and fly to endpoints around the other slot, burst quads fly out and a spinning cone of eight triangles grows on the same part); a non-negative request selects the command row indexed by the request modulo 100, packs the textures and prints the work size, a negative one draws a frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-185/315 images build the same source through french_model_variant/image4064_entry.c, without the size print and with an external scale vector, and bind the data 0xC and 0x1C lower in their raw tails. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
